windows.reason: The obstacle is the platform's ROS 2 ecosystem, not the GPU and not the port. rmcl's device code exists ONLY inside the ROS 2 package rmcl_ros (librmcl_ros_cuda, from resampling.cu and particle_motion.cu); rmcl's core carries no .cu and delegates its GPU work to rmagine. Every validated build is a colcon/ament build against ROS 2 jazzy, so with no ROS 2 there is no GPU target to build and no GPU path to test -- not a case where a subset could stand in. Verified 2026-08-20 on windows-gfx1151: no ros2 on PATH, no ROS 2 installation. wave64 (linux-gfx942) and wave32 (linux-gfx1100) are both completed at head 2b7f439c. NOTE for the approver, and the reason this is weaker than the icicle or GooFit waivers: nobody has shown rmcl CANNOT work on Windows. ROS 2 ships a Windows binary distribution. The blocker is that provisioning it -- plus colcon/ament, plus a Windows rmagine install built WITH Embree (this host validated rmagine with Embree disabled) -- is multi-step host setup and a person's decision. If you would rather have real Windows evidence than an excused gate, refuse this and provision the host instead. Honest scope note: no build was attempted, because the ROS 2 prerequisite was checked first and is absent.

windows-gfx1151.blocked_reason: No ROS 2 on this host, and rmcl's GPU code only exists inside a ROS 2 package. Every validated build of this port is a colcon/ament build of rmcl_msgs + rmcl + rmcl_ros against ROS 2 jazzy; the only object carrying device code is librmcl_ros_cuda (from rmcl_ros), built from resampling.cu and particle_motion.cu. rmcl's own core has no .cu at all -- its GPU work is delegated to rmagine. So without ROS 2 there is no GPU build target to produce and no GPU test path to exercise; this is not a case where a subset could be validated. Verified on this host 2026-08-20: no 'ros2' command on PATH and no ROS 2 installation present. Scope note, stated plainly: NO build was attempted -- the ROS 2 prerequisite was checked first and is absent, so no GPU artifact could have been produced. Validating rmcl on Windows would require provisioning the ROS 2 Windows binary distribution plus colcon/ament AND a Windows rmagine install built with Embree enabled (this host's rmagine validation deliberately ran with RMAGINE_EMBREE_DISABLE=ON). That is host provisioning work and a person's decision, not a validator action. wave64 (linux-gfx942) and wave32 (linux-gfx1100) are both completed at head 2b7f439c; windows is the only gate open.

intake.duplicate_effort: none -- no AMD/ROCm port in any of 27 upstream forks, ROCm org, or upstream docs; AMD-Ecosystem/rmcl is our own unmodified mirror (no moat-port branch)
intake.summary: ROS 2 mesh-localization stack (BSD-3, 254 stars, active); dependency rmagine already ported+validated by us, but every rmcl GPU path is gated behind OptiX -- decides on appetite for an rmcl-layer HIPRT backend plus a from-scratch test harness, since upstream ships zero tests
